metadata.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN
metadata.longDescription: Although born with tremendous power, Itadori Yuji lives a completely ordinary life. One day, to save a classmate, he eats a cursed finger, and now Ryomen Sukuna lives in Itadori's soul. Guided by the Jujutsu Sorcerers, he joins the Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School, an organization that fights the curses. Now begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to end a curse.

metadata.title: One-Punch Man
metadata.longDescription: Saitama is the strongest hero you've never heard of. After just three years of training, he can defeat enemies with one punch--which is great for saving the world, but pretty unsatisfying. Bored and bald, he joins the Hero Association to finally get some recognition. From giant crabs to alien invasions, Saitama takes on every crisis. Not out of duty--just because he has nothing better to do.

metadata.longDescription: After 18 years, we have the newest Dragon Ball story from creator Akira Toriyama.With Majin Buu defeated, Goku has taken a completely new role as...a radish farmer?! Far away, the powerful God of Destruction, Beerus, awakens to a prophecy revealing his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. When his search for the Saiyan God brings him to Earth, can Goku and his friends take on their strongest foe yet?

metadata.title: One-Punch Man

metadata.title: One-Punch Man

Not out of duty--just because he has nothing better to do.

metadata.title: One-Punch Man
metadata.longDescription: Saitama is the strongest hero you've never heard of. After just three years of training, he can defeat enemies with one punch--which is great for saving the world, but pretty unsatisfying. Bored and bald, he joins the Hero Association to finally get some recognition. From giant crabs to alien invasions, Saitama takes on every crisis. Not out of duty--just because he has nothing better to do.

When his search for the Saiyan God brings him to Earth, can Goku and his friends take on their strongest foe yet?
